category_title: Socially isolated student with ADHD who struggles with behavioral regulation and seeks adult validation
scenario_title: Independent work distraction and out-of-seat behavior
minimal_context: Jacob is supposed to be continuing with his own tasks during independent work time while sitting near another child.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent work. Please stay in your seat and continue with your own tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around a lot in order to observe what his classmates are doing)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your own paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It is difficult to concentrate because I feel I must comprehend everything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to do your assignment. (A child sitting near Jacob signals for help from the teacher)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Immediately gets up and goes over to help the nearby child)
